purpose: Fallback ledger for res://scripts/**. tests/python/test_regress_audit_cleanup.py recomputes the same sweep this file was written from and fails if a substitution site appears, disappears or loses its diagnostic without an edit here. A fallback that is visible in the log costs one line; a silent one costs a shipped regression.

policy.sweep: A function is a substitution site when its code (comments stripped) either calls/returns an identifier containing 'fallback' or constructs a stand-in primitive (BoxMesh/CapsuleMesh). Every site must be listed below, exactly once.
policy.reporting: disposition 'reports' names the function in the same file that must contain at least one diagnostic call (reported_in) and, when the site can run more than once (hot or per-mount cadence), the dedupe guard that keeps it to one line per source per session (dedupe_guard).
policy.cadence: 'hot' means the site can run every frame or every shot; 'per-build' means at most once per world/scene build; 'per-mount' means once per actor or prop mount. 'hot' and 'per-build' entries must carry a dedupe_guard.
policy.exempt: disposition 'exempt' is for values the caller already owns (a fallback argument, an authored default, a clamp) — a substitution of an authored asset is never exempt.
policy.silent_comment: no source file may describe a fallback as silent; the test greps for that too.
